answer_1.quote: we propose two sub-tasks: 1) Evidence grounded Personality State Recognition (EPR-S), which requires the model to predict the state label and provide prediction evidence from each dialogue. 2) Evidence grounded Personality Trait Recognition (EPR-T), which requires the model to predict the trait label and provide prediction evidence from one's multiple dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: personality state and trait labels with corresponding evidence (natural language reasoning process)

answer_2.quote: For the evaluation of evidence utterance IDs, we report the binary F1-score. For the evaluation of the natural language reasoning process, consisting of utterance summaries and personality characteristics, we use BERTScore to measure the semantic similarity between the ground truth and predicted evidence.

answer_3.quote: we also use claude-3-sonnet-20240229 (Anthropic, 2024) and gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 to evaluate the semantic overlapping level from 1 to 5

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 50 samples of 10 speakers for human evaluation. The annotation was performed by undergraduates majoring in psychology, and we assigned five evaluators to each sample.
answer_4.guideline: They assessed each aspect on a scale from 1 to 5, with higher scores indicating better results. Finally, we calculate the average scores of these evaluators.
